mechanism_claims.claim_text: 2D5 decreases EGF-induced EGFR Y1068 and total tyrosine phosphorylation and suppresses downstream STAT3/ERK signaling and target-gene mRNA readouts.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: 2D5 promotes EGFR localization to LAMP-1-positive lysosomes and accelerates EGFR protein loss after EGF stimulation, with text reporting an EGFR half-life of about 25 min under 2D5 versus more than 40 min in control.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Half-life values are textual approximations from the paper; graph-only band intensities are not transcribed as exact numeric rows.
